what_this_is: Founder rule B with safeguards (Stage 3D-C2, approved 7 Nov 2026): where a supplier's CURRENT terms of sale state that all its website prices include VAT, a published price on that website may be counted as VAT-inclusive. Read by atlas-tools/build-garden-room-prices.py (R-VAT), atlas-tools/publish-methodology-correction.py, Your Plot and the Maker Explorer (through priceEvidence.vatBasis = 'supplier-terms'). An accepted entry lapses 90 days after the terms were read; the guide then refuses to build until they are re-read. PlotNua records what suppliers state; it does not check or confirm any supplier's VAT rate or tax treatment.
approved: Founder Stage 3D-C2, 7 Nov 2026: 'Implement Rule B with safeguards. Hansa24: approve VAT-inclusive classification for the 21 verified products. Use the supplier-terms evidence register. Require: current supplier-wide terms; recorded source; verification date; no contradictory product wording; rate-consistency safeguard; expiry after 90 days. Irish Log Cabins: VAT remains Unknown. Powersheds: VAT remains Unknown. Pineca: preserve existing product-level evidence.'

sources.title: Revenue Tax and Duty Manual, VAT and Garden Sheds (last reviewed July 2025)
sources.finding: The supply of garden sheds and similar prefabricated structures is standard-rated; the reduced rate can apply only where the supplier erects the structure on the customer's site and the conditions (two-thirds rule, permanence, customer declaration) are met.

sources.title: Revenue VAT rates database (garden buildings / portable buildings)
sources.finding: Portable buildings are standard-rated; supply and installation as a fixture is reduced-rated.

revenueGuidance.use: The rate-consistency safeguard: a supplier statement naming a VAT rate is not relied on where that rate is inconsistent with this guidance for the kind of supply priced.

suppliers.quote: All amounts stated in these terms and conditions or on our website are stated inclusive of VAT

rateCheck.basis: The terms state no VAT rate, so no stated rate conflicts with Revenue's treatment of the supply; PlotNua does not assess the rate.

suppliers.reason: Terms 2.2 state 'All prices quoted are in Euro and include 13.5% VAT' in the invoicing clause, undated. The 13.5% rate is inconsistent with Revenue's standard rate for prefabricated buildings supplied without erection, which is what these kit prices are, so the statement fails the rate-consistency safeguard. VAT remains Unknown.
